name: pdf_pipeline
description: A CLI for extracting credit card transactions from a PDF
author: Jakob Edelstein

scripts.extract-all: for f in pdfs/*.pdf; do npm run extract "$f"; done
scripts.parse-all: for f in text/*.txt; do node src/textToJson.ts "$f"; done
scripts.csv-all: for f in transactions/*.json; do  node src/jsonToCsv.ts "$f"; done && rm -f ./csv/all.csv && touch ./csv/all.csv && for f in ./csv/*-*.csv; do sed '1d' "$f" >> ./csv/all.csv; done
